modelInteractions.description: interaction terms selected into the model RHS for this use (e.g. a treatment-by-visit interaction). Each interaction references already-bound input roles via its operands; it binds no new data. Main effects are NOT listed here — they are implied by the dimensions[]/measures[] input bindings. Empty/absent = main effects only. Validated against usesMethod's formula grammar (an interaction's operand-role multiset must match an allowed interaction production in the method's generic_expression). Input-side only (model specification is about the RHS the cube feeds), so it lives here and not on OutputDataStructure.

ModelInteraction.description: one interaction term on the model RHS, selected for this use and composed from already-bound input roles (its operands). The interaction (the `:` operator) is the only composite term selectable across the current method library; nesting/stratification (the `|` partition) is method-intrinsic, not a per-use choice, so it is not modelled here. There is therefore no `kind` discriminator: a ModelInteraction IS an interaction. If the formula grammar later gains a second selectable composition production (e.g. random effects `(slope | group)`), that is a new, separately-named construct — not a `kind` added here. The eSAP renders the model statement from these structured interactions rather than parsing a formula string.

operands.description: The two-or-more interacting factors/covariates, each a reference to an existing dimensions[]/measures[] input binding. Order is not significant (a:b == b:a).

role.description: Optional role marker for the interaction, e.g. "primary" for the treatment-by-visit term of primary interest in an MMRM.
